title: Cutoff increment between two annular integrals
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, y ∈ ℝ^P, φ : ℝ → ℝ, q, F : ℝ^P → ℝ and A, s, t ∈ ℝ, with A > 1 and 0 < s ≤ t. Assume φ is nonincreasing, 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1, φ(u) = 1 for u ≤ 1 and φ(u) = 0 for u ≥ A; q(x) ≥ 0 for every x; F(x) = q(x) whenever |x − y| > s; and x ↦ φ(|x − y|/s)q(x) and x ↦ φ(|x − y|/t)q(x) are μ-integrable. Put Δ := ∫φ(|x − y|/t)q dμ − ∫φ(|x − y|/s)q dμ. Then Δ ≥ 0 and, in [0, ∞], ∫⁻_{B̄_t(y)∖B̄_{As}(y)} ofReal(F) dμ ≤ ofReal(Δ) ≤ ∫⁻_{B̄_{At}(y)∖B̄_s(y)} ofReal(F) dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q F : Euclid P → ℝ) (A s t : ℝ), 1 < A → 0 < s → s ≤ t → Antitone φ → (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u ∧ φ u ≤ 1) → (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) → (∀ x, s < ‖x - y‖ → F x = q x) → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x) μ → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x) μ → 0 ≤ (∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ ∧ (∫⁻ x in closedBall y t \ closedBall y (A * s), ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ) ≤ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y (A * t) \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ∂μ
